decisions.reason: The explosion-proof industrial line serves the core industrial customers and its certification costs are already sunk, so keeping it costs little and its value has largely been confirmed.
This relaunch of an already popular designer task light sits close to the established offer and is cheap to keep, so the option stays open even though it ages with LED progress.
The pendant office luminaire is close to the core range and costs little to keep, and with no evidence of failure the option remains worth holding.
The premium pendant line fits the established office lighting business, and its prospects in a growing market are not yet resolved, which justifies keeping it rather than abandoning it.
